prompt: Find the surface area of a cube with edge $3$.
hint: A cube is covered by identical square faces. Work out one square and then count the squares.

hints.text: A cube is covered by identical square faces. Work out one square and then count the squares.
With an edge of $3$, one face has area $3 \times 3 = 9$. Multiply this by the number of faces on a cube.
$6 \times 9 = 54$, so the surface area of the cube is $54$ square units.

explanation: One face of the cube is a $3$ by $3$ square with area $3 \times 3 = 9$.
A cube has $6$ faces, and all of them have this same area.
Multiply to add the six equal faces: $6 \times 9 = 54$.
The surface area of the cube is $54$ square units.
